text:
noah: Heads up — vendor (GigaSource) just flagged an RMA shipment stuck in FRA customs. AWB attached below, forwarder is quoting detention/storage fees. Can ops confirm why it's held? 

noah: ```AWB: 234-98765432
Contents: 4x H100 (RMA replacements)
Manifest SNs: SN-A123..SN-A126
Hold reason: HS code mismatch / serial verification requested```

forwarder-bot: Forwarder update: FRA customs placed shipment on hold. Agent notes mismatch between provided HS code and invoice. Potential detention fee: EUR 45/day starting 2026-04-01. Possible release if documentation uploaded by customs: commercial invoice + original manifest + vendor LOA.

maria: Ugh. Did GigaSource send the LOA and photos when they booked? I asked them for photos yesterday but not sure about LOA. @noah can you paste the vendor confirmation? :eyes:

noah: Vendor email snippet: "We shipped per PO 7021, AWB 234-98765432. Attached manifest. HS code referenced was 8471.99. Please advise." No LOA attached. I'm pushing them for LOA and corrected invoice now.

aleks: If customs is asking serials we should push for live QA photos + signed LOA from vendor. Also ask forwarder to quote fast-tracked release (they can do a bonded release to depot) — that'll add handling but could avoid daily storage.

forwarder-bot: Handling options: 
- Option A: Leave in customs warehouse (EUR 45/day + EUR 150 release handling)
- Option B: Bonded release to depot (one-time EUR 320 handling, avoids daily detention)
- Option C: Return to origin (costly, ETA +3 weeks)
We can waive the daily detention if vendor signs indemnity AND manifests/documents are corrected within 48h.

jun: Can procurement push vendor to waive? This is an RMA replacement under warranty — vendor should absorb customs hiccups. We want to avoid paying storage.

rafael: I'll ping our account rep at GigaSource now. Also, check serial mismatch: is it a manifest typo or did freight guy swap cartons? We need quick photos of the carton labels.

noah: Forwarder uploaded photos (see link): https://s3.redwood/gigasource/awb-234-98765432/photos.jpg. Looks like two SN labels got transposed on the packing list. Sending to vendor for correction.

maria: Good. While vendor fixes invoice/LOA, can we ask forwarder to do bonded release option B and hold on charging storage until vendor confirms? Ask for a written waiver to present to finance.

forwarder-bot: I can hold action for 24h on request, but cannot guarantee storage waiver beyond that without vendor indemnity. Forwarder ready to execute Option B on approval. Requesting: corrected commercial invoice + LOA + signed manifest.

noah: @rafael any luck with account rep? Can they sign indemnity? If not, propose this compromise to vendor: we pay one-time bonded release handling (EUR 320) now, vendor issues credit for detention/handling after they provide LOA and corrected invoice within 7 days.

rafael: Account rep says they will sign LOA and submit corrected invoice ASAP, but procurement needs to confirm they will process a credit request. I'll forward their confirmation email in DM.

aleks: Procurement note — when you file the credit, include screenshots of forwarder's invoice and customs hold notice. Tag PO 7021 and RMA ticket #RMA-8841. Finance will need clear docs to approve vendor credit.

maria: I'll open a supplier credit request right now and attach the forwarder invoice draft. If vendor provides LOA and corrected invoice by EOD tomorrow, we can accept the bonded release and then request full reimbursement.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INF-RMA-8841. Linked: AWB 234-98765432, PO 7021. Assignees: ops@redwood, procurement. ETA milestone: vendor LOA by 2026-04-02 08:00 UTC.

noah: Sounds good. I'll approve Option B (bonded release) to avoid daily storage. Forwarder — proceed once we have vendor LOA and corrected invoice uploaded to this thread. Please hold charges until confirmation. :thumbsup:

forwarder-bot: Confirmed. Will not invoice daily detention until 2026-04-02 08:00 UTC. If LOA + corrected paperwork received and uploaded before that cutoff, detention fees will be waived per forwarder's temporary hold. Otherwise charges will apply retroactively.

maria: Thanks all — Rafael, please push vendor for LOA + signed manifest now. Jun/procurement, I'll drop the credit request and add the forwarder draft. We'll reconvene if forwarder reopens charges. :pray:
